messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Annual planning: tradeoffs & three-tier target framework (FY28)

Team —

I want to get the FY28 targets and scenario work started this week. High-level ask: we need a compact, decision-ready package for the exec QBR cycle that shows a primary plan and two downside scenarios, plus clear tradeoffs by area (revenue, ops capacity, headcount).

Proposed operating guardrails and timeline:
- Target framework: Three tiers — Base (target), Stretch (aspirational upside), Conserved (downside with hiring/headcount pauses).
- Inputs due from each function: assumptions for revenue drivers, hiring plan (H1/H2 split), and 3 cost levers you can pull. Due: 2027-06-03.
- Draft targets assembled: 2027-06-10.
- Leadership review (deep-dive): 2027-06-17.
- Exec QBR package final: 2027-06-24.

Concrete asks for this thread:
1) Confirm an owner for your function for the model + a back-up by EOD Mon (2027-05-24).
2) Share top 3 assumptions that materially move the Base number (+/- 10%).
3) Flag any non-linear capacity or procurement constraints (GPUs, infra contracts) that would affect near-term ramp.

I attached a starter workbook (FY28_target_framework_v1.xlsx) and a short QBR prework template — use these as the canonical artifacts and drop links to any supporting decks in the shared Drive folder.

I'll collate everything and send a consolidated ask tracker on Thursday. Short, pragmatic artefacts only — one-pagers preferred.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FY28_target_framework_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), QBR_prework_template.docx (doc stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: tradeoffs & three-tier target framework (FY28)

Diego — thanks for the clear ask. Quick notes from Platform/Products (owner: me):

- Owner: Vivek (models + scenario lead). Backup: Monica.
- Headcount assumptions (initial): +18 engineers in FY28 (12 in H1, 6 in H2) — this is our baseline hiring plan; downside will pause all non-critical hiring.
- Revenue sensitivity: our dealers show a ~6% ARR variance per 5% change in hosting utilization — recommend we model utilization sensitivity bands at +/-5% and +/-10% to capture infra leverage.
- Two scenarios I want modeled explicitly: 1) Higher-hosting-demand (better ops leverage), 2) Slower enterprise procure cycles (2-quarter slip).

Operational constraints: we have GPU procurement lead times of 10–14 weeks if we add dedicated capacity outside current reservations. If a scenario requires stepped capacity, we may need to budget for burst credits or cloud-on-demand premiums.

I'll drop a short sheet of headcount and cost assumptions into the Drive folder by Monday morning.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference
